feature_source: Fixed324-dimensional grayscale HOG from balloon-hog-gate-20261011; canonical64x64 RGB crops
parent: Frozen real-blue-clutter-convergence-admit-seed48 classifier; no neural weight changes
fit: Five existing source-grouped TRAIN folds. Within fitting groups use blue/background only, inverse class-frequency weights summing to0.5 each. Weighted feature mean/std(min0.001), logistic correction added to frozen parent log(blue/background) odds. L2 penalty0.1 on all correction coefficients including bias; initialize zero correction. NumPy Newton solve max500 iterations, maximum absolute gradient<1e-8; Armijo coefficient1e-4, step starts1 and halves at most40 times. No sweep or withheld-fold calibration. Replaces unavailable SciPy before any fit.
inference: Redistribute only the parent's blue+background probability mass using corrected conditional odds. Preserve red probability exactly; freeze all parent red-argmax rows. Existing acceptance threshold0.8 unchanged. A correction may rescue or reject blue; report both.
progress_gate: Source-held-out TRAIN blue F1 improves, blue false positives decrease, and neither color's min(precision,recall) decreases. Require these on both all views and deduplicated crop/view pairs. Only then consider full-scene development evaluation. This is not final94percent qualification.
scope: TRAIN-only screening, not independently held-out end-to-end accuracy. The parent classifier was already fitted on this TRAIN curriculum. Recording sessions may span multiple groups. IMG family and reserved test untouched.
